title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
**Sectigo**
is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.
  
  
  
  
**Simplicity at Scale.**
  
  
  
How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a versatile, mid-level Video/Graphic Designer to join our Brand & Creative team. In this role, you will turn complex cybersecurity and digital-trust topics into clear, compelling visual stories across video, motion, and static design. Working closely with brand, campaigns, and demand generation, you will produce on-brand creative that drives awareness, pipeline, and engagement across digital channels, events, and sales enablement. The ideal candidate pairs strong design fundamentals with hands-on video editing and motion skills, and thrives in a fast-paced B2B environment where creative directly supports measurable marketing outcomes.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* Edit, animate, and produce video content for demand generation campaigns, product launches, social media, webinars, customer stories, and sales enablement.
* Create motion graphics, animated explainers, and short-form video that simplify complex security and technical concepts for B2B audiences.
* Design and produce a broad range of marketing assets — including social graphics, digital ads, landing pages, infographics, email templates, presentations, and event collateral — that are on-brand and conversion-focused.
* Partner with campaign and demand generation managers to develop creative concepts tied to pipeline and revenue goals, then adapt assets across channels and formats.
* Apply and help evolve Sectigo’s brand guidelines, ensuring a consistent visual identity across every deliverable.
* Manage multiple projects at once, balancing quality with deadlines in a high-velocity marketing organization.
* Source, organize, and maintain creative assets, footage, stock, and templates to improve team efficiency and reuse.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (product marketing, content, web, and events) and external vendors or freelancers as needed.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to iterate on creative and improve results.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

* This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week, working in the 3PM IST schedule unless otherwise notified.
* This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Director of Account Based Marketing.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 8,00,000 and INR 11,00,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Media, Film/Video Production, Visual Communications, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience supported by a strong portfolio.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience in graphic design and video production, must be within a B2B, technology, or agency environment. A portfolio or demo reel showcasing both design and video/motion work is required.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Strong motion graphics and video editing skills, including pacing, sound, captioning, and exporting for multiple platforms and aspect ratios.
* Solid command of design fundamentals: typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience designing for digital marketing and demand generation (paid social, display, landing pages, and email).
* Familiarity with Figma and collaborative, design-system-based workflows is a plus.
* Ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into clear, engaging visuals — experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, or technology is a strong advantage.
* Comfortable working from briefs, taking creative direction, and managing feedback from multiple stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines.
* A collaborative, proactive mindset and genuine interest in how creative drives marketing performance.
* Bonus: experience with basic 3D, AI-assisted creative tools, photography, or live event/webinar production.

**Additional Information**

**Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.

Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:**

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.

**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**
  
  
  
At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

Techtinium Technologies is hiring an experienced Graphic & Video Designer to create social media content for its global customer base.

The role starts with creating content for Instagram and Facebook and will expand to YouTube over time.

You’ll work in a collaborative, thought-provoking and positive environment — one that values diversity of thought and creative solutions that are in the best interest of our global customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Graphic Design**

* Design social media creatives such as posts, carousels, stories, and campaign visuals using Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma
* Translate scientific concepts into clear, accurate, visually compelling graphics
* Maintain brand consistency across campaigns and formats

* Create motion graphics and animated explainers in After Effects that educate a broad, non-specialist audience

* Adapt content for different platforms and formats: Instagram and Facebook now, YouTube in future

* Work closely with the India team daily and present work to the customers
* Take briefs, ask good questions, and incorporate feedback quickly
* Over time, contribute to copywriting, storyboarding, and content scheduling

**Who This Role Is For**

* A designer who is equally strong in static design and video
* Someone who cares about craft and detail, and whose work looks finished rather than “good enough”
* Someone curious about science and space, who enjoys making complex ideas simple
* A clear communicator who can explain creative choices and take feedback well
* Someone who already uses AI tools as part of their professional workflow

* 3–5 years of professional experience in graphic design and video production
* Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma

* Hands-on experience using AI tools for professional video and content creation
* Experience creating content for Instagram and/or Facebook
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to work on-site from our Chennai office

* A portfolio showing both design and video work

* Experience with YouTube content or explainer/educational videos
* Storyboarding or scriptwriting experience
* Familiarity with social media scheduling and analytics tools

**Why Techtinium?**

* You will work with a highly motivated team of young professionals and have the opportunity to shape their growth
* You will get exposure to a wide range of industries and complex technical challenges
* You will get to work with diverse teams and cultures from across the globe
* Our friendly yet focused approach to work promises a lot of fun times

Techtinium is a product engineering company helping customers across the globe build technology products that serve millions of users. Over the years, some of our client engagements have grown into dedicated product companies of their own.

We are a team of expert product designers, developers, and research engineers working with customers across the globe, giving us the opportunity to experience diverse industries, cultures, and ways of thinking.

We are looking for full-stack Software Development Engineers who enjoys building high quality software that touches millions of customers. Those who seek a challenge, are eager to learn, and want to make a impact on global customers should apply.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Software Engineer will contribute to the definition, development, integration, test, documentation, and support of Java, C++ and ReactNative software across multiple digital surfaces for Kindle Readers and Applications. This hands-on position will engage your engineering capabilities and technical knowledge of software development while developing experience successfully planning, organizing, and conducting software development projects in a dynamic environment.

* Preparation of technical requirements and software design specifications.
* Understanding the internals of graphics subsystems.
* Instilling best practices for software development and documentation, making sure designs meet requirements, and delivering high quality software on tight schedules.

* ship and review C++, ReactNative or Java for reading features on Kindle E-Reader
* collaborate with peers, product owners, UX designers and partner tech teams on architecture and design of reading features.
* adapt the customer experience for the next generation of Kindle E-Reader devices focusing on operational excellence, monitoring the team's code deployment pipelines and dashboards
* root cause issues and propose solutions
* train new team-mates on how E-Reader and Kindle Application software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

We own the design, architecture, and implementation of a surface to enable reading innovation across file formats and operating systems. Our software supports Kindle customers on all major mobile surfaces and Kindle devices. Our engineers enjoy working as a team and welcome the opportunity to lead whenever possible.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience programming with C++.

Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science and Business stakeholders, you will contribute to the design and evolution of complex digital products, transforming user insights and business requirements into engaging and effective experiences.
   

  

 We work in short, iterative cycles in each Sprint. Designers here are active participants in shaping the work rather than recipients of finished specifications \- you will help the team arrive at clarity rather than wait for it. Because our products sit on top of complex healthcare data and rapidly evolving AI capabilities, Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering deliberately open up a problem space together to build shared understanding, then converge quickly on a direction and deliver.
   

  

 We are a closely knit team that shares work early, critiques generously and holds a high bar for craft. You will have real ownership of your product areas, direct access to the people who understand the data and the domain, and colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving these problems together.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Create wireframes, prototypes, design concepts and high\-fidelity designs that effectively communicate product vision and functionality
* Apply user\-centered design methodologies to ensure usability, accessibility, and adoption
* Build a thorough working understanding of the product and the business behind it, and ask the incisive early questions that establish the real user problem, the intended business outcome and the measures of success \- then design against those rather than against a feature list
* Translate complex, multi\-source healthcare data into actionable insight. Develop a working understanding of how the underlying data relates \- what drives what, what can meaningfully be compared, and where the caveats sit \- and design the information hierarchy, data presentation and visualizations so that users can see the signal, trust it, and act on it
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis and user discovery activities to inform product and design decisions
* Translate complex business requirements, workflows, and data structures into intuitive and user\-friendly experiences
* Incorporate customer feedback, user research findings and market insights to refine designs and improve product outcomes
* Operate at pace: scope your own design approach, select the right fidelity for the decision at hand, and iterate as the team's understanding of the problem sharpens
* Perform AI\-driven product design and prototyping, and apply AI tooling to accelerate your own exploration and delivery
* Follow and help strengthen the defined UX guidelines, standards, and best practices across teams
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high\-quality user experiences
* Participate in usability testing, stakeholder workshops, design reviews, and design\-thinking sessions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment) The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in UX / Product Design, including hands\-on experience designing for data\-rich or analytics\-driven products
* Hands\-on experience with user research, usability testing, stakeholder workshops, and design sprint activities
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG / Section 508\) and inclusive design principles
* Proficiency in Figma and other industry\-standard design and prototyping tools
* Demonstrated product thinking: a track record of understanding product and business requirements quickly, asking the right questions of stakeholders, and producing design solutions that demonstrably serve both user needs and business goals. Portfolio should evidence the reasoning, not only the screens
* Proven ability to work with data hierarchy, data architecture and complex data relationships and to propose best\-in\-class designs for presenting them cdashboards, drill\-downs, comparative and benchmarked views, and insight\-led layouts that lead users to a decision
* Proven ability to work with self\-direction in areas of ambiguity: you can take an early or evolving problem statement, structure it, seek out the information you need, and move it forward without every step being defined for you
* Proven ability to work effectively in a high\-velocity, cross\-functional environment \- responsive to new information, efficient in revision, and pragmatic about sequencing what ships now versus what follows
* Proven ability to communicate product and design intent through demo\-ready prototypes and clear narrative \- work that travels well to customers, executives and internal stakeholders
* Proven ability to translate user needs, business goals and technical constraints into thoughtful design solutions
* Proven solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to product, engineering, data science and business audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of experience building products in the US healthcare analytics domain, with familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare data platforms, interoperability standards or population health analytics
* Experience designing for probabilistic or predictive outputs \- communicating confidence, uncertainty and recommendation provenance so that users know how much to trust what they are seeing
* Experience partnering with Product / Data Science / ML teams and defining success metrics for AI\-driven experiences, including generative AI, predictive analytics, conversational interfaces and intelligent workflows
* Knowledge of data visualization best practices and experience designing complex dashboards, reporting and analytics solutions
